# Changes credited to the programme

In this section, we harmonize section 15 of the questionnaire, asked from the 2022 PDM onwards: in which areas the household says taking part in the activities changed its situation, and for each area selected, whether it decreased, stayed stable or increased. The areas are income, food consumption, use of coping strategies, ability to cope with shocks, ability to diversify the diet, ability to care for children, children's school attendance and acquisition of assets.

* The areas come from a multiple-choice question, one 0/1 column per area. The 2023 PDM stores them as text: converted to numbers.
* The direction is asked only for the areas selected: 1 = decreased, 2 = stable, 3 = increased.
* These are the household's own views on the programme's effect, not measured changes.

```{r 29 packages needed}
library(haven)
library(labelled)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r 29 remove environment variables}
rm(list = ls())
```

```{r 29 environment settings}
dir_input_data = "C:/Users/AHema/OneDrive - CGIAR/Desktop/WFP Resilience dataset/data/input_data/Chad"
dir_output_data = "C:/Users/AHema/OneDrive - CGIAR/Desktop/WFP Resilience dataset/data/output_data/Chad"
```

```{r 29 read harmonization excel file}
Chad_Harmonization_variables <- read_excel(paste0(dir_input_data, "/Chad_Harmonization_extension.xlsx"), sheet = "variables_harmonization") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Module == "Effects")
Chad_Harmonization_description <- read_excel(paste0(dir_input_data, "/Chad_Harmonization.xlsx"), sheet = "description")
Chad_Harmonization_ID <- read_excel(paste0(dir_input_data, "/Chad_Harmonization.xlsx"), sheet = "variables_harmonization") %>%
  dplyr::filter(NewVariable_Name == "ID")
```

```{r 29 data importation}
lst_data = Chad_Harmonization_description$Data
lst_test = Chad_Harmonization_description$Name
for (i in 1:length(lst_data)) {
  assign(lst_test[i], read_sav(paste0(dir_input_data, "/", lst_data[i])))
}
```

```{r 29 select and rename columns needed}
# Text answers ("" or "0"/"1") are converted to numbers; an empty text is missing
to_num <- function(z) { z <- zap_labels(z); if (is.character(z)) { z <- trimws(z); z[z == ""] <- NA; stopifnot(all(z %in% c(as.character(0:9), NA))) }; as.numeric(z) }
for (j in 1:length(lst_test)) {
  raw <- get(lst_test[j], envir = .GlobalEnv)
  df <- tibble::tibble(.rows = nrow(raw))
  id_var <- Chad_Harmonization_ID[[lst_test[j]]]
  df$ID <- if (is.na(id_var)) NA_character_ else { z <- zap_labels(raw[[id_var]]); if (is.numeric(z)) format(z, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE) else as.character(z) }
  for (i in 1:nrow(Chad_Harmonization_variables)) {
    v <- Chad_Harmonization_variables[[lst_test[j]]][i]
    df[[Chad_Harmonization_variables$NewVariable_Name[i]]] <- if (is.na(v)) NA_real_ else to_num(raw[[v]])
  }
  assign(lst_test[j], df)
}
Chad_pdm_2022$ID = as.character(1:nrow(Chad_pdm_2022))
```

## Merging all data

```{r}
vars <- Chad_Harmonization_variables$NewVariable_Name
changed <- grep("^EffChanged_", vars, value = TRUE); direction <- grep("^EffDirection_", vars, value = TRUE)
df_Chad <- dplyr::bind_rows(mget(lst_test))
for (v in changed) stopifnot(all(df_Chad[[v]] %in% c(0, 1, NA)))
for (v in direction) stopifnot(all(df_Chad[[v]] %in% c(1:3, NA)))
# The direction is asked only for the areas selected
for (k in sub("^EffChanged_", "", changed)) print(c(k, sum(!is.na(df_Chad[[paste0("EffDirection_", k)]]) & !(df_Chad[[paste0("EffChanged_", k)]] %in% 1))))
```

```{r}
for (v in changed) df_Chad[[v]] <- labelled(df_Chad[[v]], c("No" = 0, "Yes" = 1))
for (v in direction) df_Chad[[v]] <- labelled(df_Chad[[v]], c("Decreased" = 1, "Stable" = 2, "Increased" = 3))
for (i in 1:nrow(Chad_Harmonization_variables)) var_label(df_Chad[[Chad_Harmonization_variables$NewVariable_Name[i]]]) <- Chad_Harmonization_variables$Label[i]
var_label(df_Chad$ID) <- "Household ID"
```

## Export all data

```{r}
df_Chad <- df_Chad %>% dplyr::select(ID, all_of(vars))
haven::write_dta(df_Chad, paste0(dir_output_data, "/", "WFP_Chad_Effects.dta"))
```
